title: Trainee Engineering Technician
abstract: Launch your engineering career with KSB Australia through a Certificate III in Engineering - Technical
bullets: Complete a nationally recognised Certificate III in Engineering - Technical
Earn while you learn in a professional engineering environment
Ongoing mentoring, guidance and support throughout your traineeship
screening_questions: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
Do you have a current Australian driver's licence?
Do you own or have regular access to a car?
Do you have any other qualifications, tickets or pre-apprenticeships? (Cert II)
What interests you about completing a Traineeship in Technical Engineering?
content_text:
About the role: 
 KSB Australia is a leading supplier of pumps, valves and fluid handling systems, servicing a diverse range of industries across Australia. Working alongside experienced engineers and technical specialists, you will gain practical exposure to engineering documentation, project support, technical reporting, quality processes and engineering operations.
 This 12-month traineeship provides an excellent pathway into an engineering career, developing technical knowledge and workplace skills while completing your qualification.
 Your duties may include:
 - Assisting with the preparation and maintenance of engineering documentation and records
 - Interpreting technical drawings, specifications and engineering instructions
 - Supporting project planning, scheduling and reporting activities
 - Collecting, recording and analysing technical data
 - Assisting with quality assurance and quality control processes
 - Using CAD and engineering software to support engineering activities
 - Participating in product testing, inspections and technical evaluations
 - Maintaining workplace safety standards and following company procedures
 - Communicating with engineers, production personnel and customers
 - Contributing to continuous improvement initiatives within the engineering team
 Location: Hope Valley, WA
 Work hours: Monday to Friday 8.00am to 4.00pm
 Duration: 12 months
 What’s in it for you?
 - Gain a Nationally recognised Certificate III in Engineering – Technical qualification
 - All training fees and PPE are provided
 - Mentoring from experienced industry professionals helping you complete your apprenticeship
 - Be supported by a dedicated Consultant throughout your employment
 About you:
 - Must be an Australian Citizen or permanent resident with the right to work in Australia
 - Minimum completion of Year 12 High School
 - Have a genuine interest in engineering and technology
 - Demonstrate strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills
 - Possess good written and verbal communication skills
 - Be comfortable working with computers and technical software
 - Have the ability to follow procedures and work safely
 - Be motivated to learn and contribute as part of a team
 About Australian Industry Group 
 Australian Industry Group Apprentice and Trainee Centre is a Group Training Organisation, partnering with Australia's best companies, producing powerful outcomes for apprentices and trainees. We foster connections with communities, employers, and candidates to create ideal career opportunities.  
 To learn more about us, please visit our website www.aigroupapprentices.com.au
 If you want to be the best, you need to learn from the best!  Apply now!
 Please note only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
 Australian Industry Group believes in the strength of a diverse workforce. We welcome female applicants, those who identify as First Nations people, and applicants from culturally and linguistically diverse backgrounds or are members of the LGBTQIA+ community to apply.
